title: Hit Target pH: Exact Neutrality
description: Adjust an acidic solution of hydrochloric acid by adding sodium hydroxide until the pH meter reads exactly 7.0 (± 0.2).

title: Mystery Solution: Acid or Base?
description: You are given an unlabeled solution 'Unknown-A'. Use indicators to determine whether it is acidic, basic, or neutral.
objective: Identify 'Unknown-A' as an acid, base, or neutral substance.

title: Speed Precipitate: Silver Chloride
description: Produce at least 1.0 gram of white silver chloride precipitate before the 30-second timer runs out.
objective: Form silver chloride precipitate in under 30 seconds.

title: Gas Collector: Carbon Dioxide
description: Evolve 100 mL of carbon dioxide gas using acid and carbonate reagents without overflowing the vessel.

title: Balance Chemical Equation: Sulfuric Acid + Base
description: Provide the correct stoichiometric coefficients for the reaction: _ H2SO4 + _ NaOH -> _ Na2SO4 + _ H2O.
objective: Correctly balance the neutralization chemical equation.

title: Periodic Mystery: Element #26
description: Deduce the unknown element with 26 protons, electron configuration [Ar] 3d6 4s2, and high magnetic susceptibility.

title: Freeze Challenge: Maximum Endothermic Cooling
description: Lower solution temperature by at least 10 °C using endothermic dissolving salts.

title: Metal Coating: Electroplate Copper
description: Plating a metal electrode with bright copper using copper sulfate solution.

title: Select Correct Reagent: Sulfate Cation Test
description: Choose the correct chemical from the shelf to confirm the presence of sulfate ions in a solution.

title: Foam Tower: Maximum Elephant Toothpaste
description: Optimize reactant ratios of H2O2 and catalyst to reach maximum foam evolution rate.
objective: Trigger peak decomposition gas evolution rate.
